name: Make Me a Cocktail
author: Nick Wilkins

sections.description:
Choose from 4 options to display a cocktail recipe on your site. You can choose from a completely random cocktail, a top highly rated cocktail, a cocktail by name or a cocktail by ingredient. The widget is powered by makemeacocktail.com and will display a cocktail recipe from their database of over 3000 recipes.

You have a choice of display options to customise the widget to your site, including the size of the widget, the colour of the text and the background. If you would like to see more options, please let us know.

External Service

This plugin loads recipe data from MakeMeACocktail.com. A script is fetched from that domain to display the widget selected in the admin area. No account is required but your widget configuration will be sent to MakeMeACocktail.com to generate the embed. See the privacy policy and terms of use for details.

Arbitrary section

Powered by makemeacocktail.com link will be shown on the widget. If you would like to remove this link, please contact us at https://makemeacocktail.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload makemeacocktail to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Make Me a Cocktail Plugin settings page to create and use a shortcode
  4. Place the shortcode anywhere on your site
sections.faq:
What cocktail recipes do you have that I can choose from

We have around 3000 recipes that you can choose from, and have tried to cover all the classics and some more modern creations. If you have a specific recipe you would like to see, please let us know.

Can I customise the widget

There are a host of visual display options that you can choose from, including the size of the widget, the colour of the text and the background. If you would like to see more options, please let us know.

Can I remove the link to makemeacocktail.com

Yes, you can remove the link to makemeacocktail.com by contacting us at https://makemeacocktail.com/

How to uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin.
